tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Shell. Page background for every screen.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, list rows and inputs raised off `paper`.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Stone. Hairline dividers between rows and sections; card borders instead of shadows.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Soft fills, selected chrome, and informational tags. Text on it is `ink`.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Honeydew. Soft fill and action-needed tags (Needs someone). Text on it is `ink`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Viridian. Headlines, body copy and amounts on light surfaces.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text — dates, captions, helper text — on `paper` and `surface`.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Viridian. Primary action buttons (Done, settle, New Area). Text on it is `on-color`.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Sky alias for soft brand fills. Prefer `sky`. Text on it is `ink`.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Soft green fill for on-time / success status tags. Text on it is `success-ink`.

tokens.name: success-ink
tokens.usage: Dark green text on `success`.

tokens.name: success-mid
tokens.usage: One shade darker than `success` — on-time chart bars.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Green text for money owed to you (≥4.5:1 on `paper` and `surface`). Money you owe uses `danger`.

tokens.name: olive
tokens.usage: Soft olive fill for completed-late tags. Text on it is `olive-ink`.

tokens.name: olive-ink
tokens.usage: Dark olive text on `olive`.

tokens.name: olive-mid
tokens.usage: One shade darker than `olive` — late chart bars.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Solid red for overdue counts and destructive buttons. Text on it is `on-color`.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Soft red fill for still-open overdue status tags. Text on it is `danger-ink`.

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Dark red text on `danger-soft` (≥4.5:1).

tokens.name: on-color
tokens.usage: Text and icons on solid `accent` and `danger` fills.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring, offset 2px, on every surface.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label; between an amount and its currency note.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked lines inside a row; chip padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and row padding; gap between list rows.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections; page side margin on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, checkboxes, table cells.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, buttons.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Roommate chips, status tags and split badges.
